lesson.title: Compass Directions & Positions
lesson.subtitle: Compass directions, regions, and relative positions
lesson.description: Describe compass directions, northern and southern regions, nearby spots, and relative positions.

learning_objectives: Name the four cardinal and four intercardinal directions: 东, 南, 西, 北, 东北, 东南, 西北, 西南.
Talk about regions and orientation: 北方, 南方, 东方, 西方, and 方向.
Describe relative location with 中, 中间, 附近, 面前, 到处, and 向.

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 3 learners with Level 1-2 foundations

overview.topic_description: Spatial orientation, compass points, and regional terms in HSK 3.
overview.focus: Note that Mandarin combines 东/西 before 南/北 for intercardinal directions (东北, 西南), and places 向 before a direction.

grammar_points.title: Using 北方 (běifāng)
grammar_points.explanation: 北方 (běifāng) means “the north; northern region” (noun).

questions.prompt: What two aspects are mentioned as different between northern and southern China?
questions.explanation: The first sentence mentions 在饮食、天气上都有一些不同.

questions.prompt: Write two sentences giving directions using 向……走 and 附近 or 中间.
questions.answer: 向北走三分钟，你会看到一家银行，它就在超市和医院中间。
questions.explanation: Use 向 + direction + verb and 在……中间.
Chinese always orders 东/西 before 南/北: 东北.

dialogue.title: Checking Directions on a Map
dialogue.context_en: Two friends look at a map to plan a trip and find a nearby restaurant.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你看地图，哈尔滨在中国的东北方向，冬天很冷。
turns.pinyin: Nǐ kàn dìtú, Hā’ěrbīn zài Zhōngguó de dōngběi fāngxiàng, dōngtiān hěn lěng.
turns.english: Look at the map—Harbin is in the northeast direction of China, so winter is very cold.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对，北方和南方的气候差别很大，西南那边冬天就暖和得多。
turns.pinyin: Duì, běifāng hé nánfāng de qìhòu chābié hěn dà, xīnán nàbiān dōngtiān jiù nuǎnhuo de duō.
turns.english: Right, the climate in the north and south differs a lot; the southwest is much warmer in winter.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 咱们先别看远的地方了，附近哪儿有吃饭的地方？
turns.pinyin: Zánmen xiān bié kàn yuǎn de dìfang le, fùjìn nǎr yǒu chīfàn de dìfang?
turns.english: Let’s not look at faraway places for now—where nearby is there a place to eat?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 向东走两百米，就在银行和书店的中间，面前有个小广场。
turns.pinyin: Xiàng dōng zǒu liǎng bǎi mǐ, jiù zài yínháng hé shūdiàn de zhōngjiān, miànqián yǒu ge xiǎo guǎngchǎng.
turns.english: Walk east 200 meters; it’s right between the bank and the bookstore, with a small square in front.

patterns.title: Facing or moving toward a direction with 向
patterns.explanation_en: Place 向 (xiàng) + direction/person before the action verb.

examples.hanzi: 出了地铁站以后，向南走五分钟就到了。
examples.pinyin: Chū le dìtiězhàn yǐhòu, xiàng nán zǒu wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.english: After exiting the subway station, walk south for five minutes and you’re there.
Please everyone look toward the left.

patterns.title: Between two places with 在……中间
patterns.explanation_en: Use 在 + A + 和 + B + 中间 to locate something between two landmarks.
patterns.pattern_hanzi: 在 + <Place A> + 和 + <Place B> + 中间

examples.hanzi: 邮局在医院和学校中间。
examples.pinyin: Yóujú zài yīyuàn hé xuéxiào zhōngjiān.
examples.english: The post office is between the hospital and the school.

examples.hanzi: 他站在我们中间照了一张相。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài wǒmen zhōngjiān zhào le yì zhāng xiàng.
examples.english: He stood in the middle of us and took a photo.

guided_building.instruction_en: Describe compass directions, regions, and nearby places.

model.hanzi: 春天的时候，公园里到处都是花。
model.pinyin: Chūntiān de shíhou, gōngyuán lǐ dàochù dōu shì huā.
model.english: In spring, there are flowers everywhere in the park.

substitutions.cue_en: Say Beijing is in northern China.
Say there is a tall tree right in front of the house.

model_answer.pinyin: Fángzi miànqián yǒu yì kē dà shù.
model_answer.english: There is a big tree in front of the house.

substitutions.cue_en: Say this city is in the southeast.

model_answer.hanzi: 这座城市在国家的东南边。
model_answer.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì zài guójiā de dōngnán biān.
model_answer.english: This city is in the southeast of the country.

paragraphs.hanzi: 中国的北方和南方在饮食、天气上都有一些不同。北方人常吃面食，南方人更习惯吃米饭。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhōngguó de běifāng hé nánfāng zài yǐnshí, tiānqì shàng dōu yǒu yìxiē bù tóng. Běifāng rén cháng chī miànshí, nánfāng rén gèng xíguàn chī mǐfàn.
paragraphs.english: Northern and southern China have some differences in food and weather. Northerners often eat wheat-based foods, while southerners are more used to eating rice.

paragraphs.hanzi: 至于东方和西方文化，也有各自的特点。现在交通方便，到处都能尝到各地的美食。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhìyú dōngfāng hé xīfāng wénhuà, yě yǒu gèzì de tèdiǎn. Xiànzài jiāotōng fāngbiàn, dàochù dōu néng chángdào gèdì de měishí.
paragraphs.english: As for Eastern and Western cultures, each has its own features too. Now transportation is convenient, and you can taste regional delicacies everywhere.

questions.prompt_en: What staple food difference is mentioned between northern and southern China?
questions.answer_en: Northerners often eat wheat-based foods while southerners are more used to rice.

questions.prompt_en: Why can you taste regional delicacies everywhere now?

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Give simple compass directions from your home or school.

model_answer.hanzi: 从我家出门向西走，附近就有一个地铁站。
model_answer.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā chūmén xiàng xī zǒu, fùjìn jiù yǒu yí ge dìtiězhàn.
model_answer.english: Walk west out of my home and there is a subway station nearby.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Say where two places are relative to each other using 中间 or 附近.

model_answer.hanzi: 图书馆在教学楼和体育馆中间，附近还有一家书店。
model_answer.pinyin: Túshūguǎn zài jiàoxuélóu hé tǐyùguǎn zhōngjiān, fùjìn hái yǒu yì jiā shūdiàn.
model_answer.english: The library is between the classroom building and the gym, and there’s a bookstore nearby.

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: Chinese puts East/West first in intercardinal directions: 东北 (northeast), 东南 (southeast), 西北 (northwest), 西南 (southwest) — never *北东 or *南西.
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: 方向 (fāngxiàng) pairs flat fāng with falling xiàng; 中间 (zhōngjiān) has two high flat first tones.

can_do: Contrast 北方, 南方, 东方, and 西方.
Give directions with 向, 附近, 面前, and 中间.
